rationale: Default: risk spread evenly over the term (also the usual legal basis for refunds)
New vehicles: the manufacturer warranty covers the early months so claims arrive late
Used vehicles: wear-related claims start soon after sale and level off
GAP: the loan balance and so the gap exposure is largest early in the term
Maintenance: services are used by mileage as much as by time
RV and powersports: usage varies widely so earn on the greater of time and mileage
Technology coverage carries a mileage limit
